Mexican Documents: Authorities and Price Bands

Every document in Mexico comes from a different office. This hub lists all six with the office that issues it and the observed band, so you can pick the right page before you open a chat.

Price bands differ by document by an order of magnitude and the checks differ completely. Read the office column before the price column, because the office tells you what the document is and the price only tells you what a seller hopes to get for it.

Mexican documents: the six offices

Issuing office by document.
DocumentOfficeObserved
Passportthe SRE2600–9500 MXN
Driving Licencethe state Secretaria de Movilidad1800–7000 MXN
ID Cardthe civil registry or INE1300–4800 MXN
Green Cardthe INM4800–15500 MXN
Visaa Mexican consulate2200–8000 MXN
Residence Permitthe INM4600–14000 MXN

Two checks specific to Mexico

  • Check the licence for the state secretariat named in the header and the state specific number format.
  • Confirm the passport eagle printing and the machine-readable zone check digits.

Local red flag

  • A licence whose header names a state that does not issue that format.
